page.layout: One printed page (left), one block of running text with a marginal note in the left margin. The partial right-hand page at the scan edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Non ita multò post {y}Abimelech se-cum confœderatis Sichemitis aditum fi-bi ad regni gubernacula patefecit, occi-sione virorum septuaginta é Regia stir-pe, solo relicto Ioathamo natu minimo, sed hujus nefandi sceleris exitum pauli-sper expectante: precatur Ioathamus ex amaritudine animæ suæ, ut egrediretur ignis de viris Sichem, & devoraret Abi-melech, quod ibidem factitatum legi-mus. Posuit nempe Dominus spiritum pes-simum inter Abimelech & Sichemitas, ita ut cœperint eum odisse, & scelus interfectionis septuaginta virorum, & effusionem sanguinis eorum in eum conferre. Quare surrexit ac irruit in eos, cepitq; urbem, & interfectis civibus, ipsaq; vastata sal in ea despergit, Turrim insuper excelsam succendit, & in ea mille hominum, fumo & igne vel suffocavit, vel combusit, & ipse tandem manu mulieris fragmen molæ desuper jacientis illiso capite, & confracto cerebro miserè periit. Ita reddidit Deus malum quod fecerat Abimelech contra Patrem suum interfectis septuaginta fratribus suis Sichemitis quoq; quod operati erant, retribu-tumIud. 9.

page.notes: Marginal note "Iud. 9." is printed in italic in the left margin beside "Abimelech", keyed to the mark y. Italic runs are approximate where the scan is faint. The Hebrew-less page has no Greek or Hebrew. Long s rendered as s throughout. Printed hyphens are kept at the line ends "occi-", "stir-", "pauli-", "Abi-", "legi-", "retribu-". No catchword or signature is printed.
